comment: Intentional non-canonical color utility classes (UI/UX #7421). Canonical neutrals are gray-*, canonical primary is blue-*. Entries here are categorical/semantic colors that are NOT neutrals or primary accents, reviewed and kept on purpose. Format: 'relative/path/from/ui/src': ['reason'].

allow.components/model-explorer/ModelTree.tsx: purple/yellow distinguish source vs target model and swap-selection state in Frankenstein mode (categorical, not a primary accent)
purple marks the source model name in cross-model diffs (categorical)
purple is the 'Utility' tile-category badge color (categorical taxonomy, not a primary action)

rawPaletteCeiling.description: Ratchet ceiling for raw gray-* and blue-* Tailwind classes across ui/src (issue #14252). Current baseline after Settings.tsx migration is 2,327. CI fails if total raw classes exceed this budget.
